notes.title: Keyboard and mouse controls have been added!
notes.notes:
Keyboard and mouse controls have been added!

I was a bit afraid of adding keyboard and mouse controls, since the game was really designed around the 2 sticks on the controller. It works surprisingly well though, try it out! It's still a work in progress so there may be some issues, if you have any problems or suggestions drop them in the Discord. https://discord.gg/JQdSGug
